user_reviews.title: Pretty good
user_reviews.review_text: To be frank product is so good but if you are really looking for value for money then can consider the old generation as its maxed out at around 700-780mbps and although 500mbps in most work is kore than enough. System i tested this on is macbook m1 thunderbolt port and msi laptop the speed is good but there are some major cons also Pros: 1. Speed is good 2. Light weight 3. Super small and easy to carry 4. Best customer service and can be used as a live boot for windows(works awesome without any lag) Cons: 1. Little costly (because thunderbolts standard) 2. In my case doesn't archived 1050mbps advertised speed 3. Its heats a lot when in big transfer occurring (i mean really hot around 60-70 degree celcius) 4. Wont suitable for everyone like if you know why are you buying this high then only worth otherwise a simple ssd. user_reviews.review_text: Main purpose of buying this SSD for 4k video transfer from mobile phone to SSD & can shoot more video in 4k. OnePlus 6T 4k@60fps can shoot 5min of video size around 8GB so 1hour of video size around 96GB Almost getting mobile internal memory Full Now the main part transferring this huge amount of video size need faster external SSD Test 1:- I have tested 96GB transfer in 20 min and mobile battery drop-down from 94% to 76% pretty well speed, but SSD is getting hotter because of big amount of size Test 2:- Transfer same amount of size in 4 part sagment to check whether it will become hot or not Surprise result it's warm little bit not much as first time This time it's little warm but speed of transfer is same (faster) In computer yet to test but will post some real transfer speed of data. Very happy with this product purchase
